model: A local reduced resource-competition model:R=S-C*N,and dN_i/dt=N_i*((G*R)_i-d). Columns of Care species and rows are resources;rows of Gare species. Interpret this as a local calibrated working model only in a neighborhood with N>0and R>0. A positive coexistence equilibrium solves G*R=d*ones and S-R=C*N. Local stability must use the density Jacobian of the full reduced equations,including resource feedback:at coexistence J=-diag(N)*G*C. A feasible intersection is not automatically stable. Do not extrapolate this local linear resource relation to negative-resource states or claim a global ecological outcome.
target: Return the positive coexistence resource vector and population vector in source order,the local density Jacobian,and its largest real eigenvalue. Report whether that equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable.

provenance.kind: Explicit small synthetic benign scientific model;data are conditional exact counts/means and do not establish empirical ecological,causal or functional claims.
